**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed).

- **Direction check:** all licence flow in this agreement runs from IBM (us) to MSL — § 13.3(a) (no rights in IBM preexisting IP beyond a confidential-information use licence to manufacture solely for IBM), § 5 of the Equipment and Program Loan Agreement (Loaned Programs licensed to MSL), Attachment 6 / § 24.1 (restrictions on MSL's use of IBM and Microsoft software). Those restrictions favour us and were not flagged.
- **Why compliant:** instead of a licence to us, § 13.1 gives IBM outright ownership, with assignment by MSL, of all IP in the hardware, software, design and documentation of delivered Products and of inventions on Products and IBM processes. Ownership exceeds the preferred position — nothing is revocable, and as owner we can extend use to Related Companies and contractors and transfer to successors.
- **Noted, not flagged:** § 24.1(a)/(b) ("MSL conveys to IBM no software title or license under the intellectual property rights of MSL or of any third party"; no licence rights or source code without the owner's approval). This is mutual, sits outside the Product IP we own, and preserves a consent path, so it does not fail the fallback.
